item.description: Hermope #4466 the Twice-Born was broken in the archipelago (the stone in their midst (House of Pelorus)). The bones lie scattered in Asphodel and will knit again; only fire unmakes the Sown.

item.title: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Hermope #4466 the Twice-Born
item.description: Like Aethalides, who passes between the living and the dead, Hermope #4466 the Twice-Born rose from Asphodel and returned to the Field of Ares. Hermope has drunk from Lethe 2 times and remembers little.
